transcript.text: buff you know with the damage. So,
they're just kind of like returning the
favor by nerfing the decoy and honestly
I mess with it a lot cuz the Evo Barrel
is kind of toxic but the regular barrel
is kind of weak. So, maybe it helps like
bridge the gap a little bit. And this
one guys, I am very very happy about.
One of my favorite ones that I honestly
never thought would get changed but
finally did. The evolved Goblin Cage is
finally getting a nerf. You beat down
players are going to be super happy
about this one. The cycle for the Goblin
Cage is going from one to two. So, now
instead of every other Goblin Cage being
Evo, it'll now be every third Goblin
Cage being Evo which makes a lot of
sense. Goblin Cage was the only one
cycle Evo for four elixir and I do think
that it showed in how strong that it
actually ended up being. Very very in
agreeance with that one. And Evo Mega
Knight guys, I bet a lot of you Mega
Knight haters are super happy right now
jumping for joy. The Evo Mega Knight
will now knock back every other attack
instead of every attack, so just making
it a little bit worse against some of
the things that it is extremely strong
against, but the heavy troop knockback
is going from two tiles two and a half
tiles to four tiles, so
it will knock the troops back further,
but it won't knock them back every hit
like before, making it quite a bit less
polarizing.
Evo Valkyrie is getting a tornado damage
reduction by 50%, so now once again,
like in the past when it came out, it
will no longer one shot skeletons or
bats. You will have to be, you know,
getting two swings to take out skeletons
and bats, which I think is a fair
change. Evo Valkyrie has just been way
too strong for way too long now. Glad
they're finally starting to try and
address this issue. Although, I don't
know if it'll be too weak because I
remember before when it was like this,
it was too weak because too many things
just attacked it at once and killed it,
but we will see. We will definitely see
graveyard gets a pretty big indirect
buff there because of that.
And now, guys, my two favorite balance
changes in terms of the nerfs, dude, or
like I guess excluding evolutions, but
two ones that I have wanted for so long,
they are nerfing the Bowler and the
Executioner projectile range. They are
going from 7.5 range to a seven range,
which is 7% and half of a tile. I am so
so so happy with this, guys, because for
the longest time, I have complained and
complained that the Bowler and the
Executioner were basically just magic
archers with 7,000 HP, and I will still
stand on that, man. Half of the time
when you're against those cards, they
are the things that take out your tower,
not even like the win condition, which
is crazy to say, right? But I swear it
was way more often than than you would
think, to be honest, where the
Executioner and the Bowler would just
end up becoming your win condition. So,
hopefully, with this, you know, they are
now more used for their purpose instead
of just being extremely broken. And they
are doing another nerf to the Goblin
Drill, guys. This one was a surprise to
me and very very new that that added
because of the goblins buff, they're
also taking away the crown tower damage
from the Goblin Drill. So now there will
no longer be any guaranteed damage from
just dropping a Goblin Drill on the
tower and I am not too sure if I agree
with this cuz I did feel like that maybe
Goblin Drill got a pretty big nerf in
general just by getting the Evo snowball
nerfed. So I think that this might be a
bit much. We will see maybe it's just
unnecessary though. I do like that
they're testing it out for sure. But I
personally think that it is just too
much and maybe
might need to be reverted in the future
if the Goblin Drill usage rate drops too
low.
They're also nerfing the Wall Breakers
which also affects the Evo Wall Breakers
I believe. I am super happy about this.
The Wall Breakers damage is being nerfed
by 20% mainly to just make it not so
punishing if you end up taking a little
bit of damage from the Wall Breakers cuz
before right? They're two elixir and
they take out like a fourth of your
tower. Like do you know how ridiculous
that sounds? They're so low elixir but
they will literally lose you the game if
they connect to the tower like two
times. Like that's half your tower gone
just like that. And just for two elixir.
That was definitely far too strong. Very
happy to see that happen and to be
honest I didn't think it would happen
cuz they've
been against it for so long but I guess
finally they decided like yeah maybe now
is the time to you know get that done.
They're also nerfing the Magic Archer
which I am very happy about this. I was
honestly surprised that they added this
to the balance change cuz for some
reason I just had a feeling that they
weren't going to nerf the Magic Archer
maybe cuz they've been nerfing it too
much recently. Although it was still
clearly way too strong. It just seemed
like they weren't going in the direction
to nerf it which definitely had me upset
about changes so them adding the Magic
Archer to it makes me very happy and
makes me pretty hopeful for the balance
team in the future to be honest like
where they're actually able to listen to
feedback. I feel like this is definitely
the most feedback driven you know set of
work in progress changes I've ever seen.
They definitely worked on it a lot man
unlike maybe some other seasons where it
felt like maybe they didn't listen to
like our thoughts as much. Definitely
very happy to feel uh considered I guess
in this balance change. Definitely can't
complain about that.
Another thing they're doing is nerfing
the Royal Delivery. I think that's a
very good change as well because Royal
Delivery has just been too good for too
long now and it's kind of like the
staple of like all of these deck that
have like decks that have like crazy
cycle cards and shouldn't really get
away with it. People have starting like
have started to put Royal Delivery in
them just making it so so impossible to
break through. They are also adding a
hit speed nerf to the Zappies. Very big
fan of the hit speed nerf to the Zappies
cuz I have felt like the Zappies were
too good for a little bit too long now.
I just think that the Zappies got maybe
one too many buffs in a balance change
